ONLY bitty-ai-slice (integration harness) consumes real bitty-ipc via IpcBridge (authorize_method + ConsentLedger + IpcEndpoint + envelope validators) with IdentityBridge protocol-to-wire client_id binding (AI-0065). ai.* handler LOGIC exists only as S2 envelope shapes in bitty-ai-host modules + runtime ToolBus dispatch; none behind an IPC endpoint yet.
